compiled_state.title: As the CI review pipeline, I receive a REVIEW_CONTEXT: ci marker so diff-boundary discipline is enforced in CI reviews
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Modify llm-api-call.sh to prepend "REVIEW_CONTEXT: ci" as a single line to the user message payload for all CI-dispatched reviews. Add a diff-boundary discipline section to reviewer-base.md that instructs agents to only flag bugs about code visible in the provided diff when the marker is present, and explicitly permits full-codebase reasoning when the marker is absent. Rebuild all 10 reviewer agent files.

**Why**: Without a CI context marker, reviewers cannot distinguish CI (diff-only) from local (full codebase) context. This causes hallucinated findings referencing code that isn't in the diff — the single largest source of invalid findings in PR #37.

**Scope**:
- IN: llm-api-call.sh CI detection and REVIEW_CONTEXT: ci prepend; diff-boundary discipline section in reviewer-base.md; rebuild of all 10 agent files; negative test verifying marker is absent outside CI
- OUT: How other CI dispatch scripts (2fa0-a2d9 context-augmentation loop, 88d2-6756 CodeQL gates) interact with the marker — gate: REVIEW_CONTEXT: ci prepended as a single line and does not alter message structure

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, llm-api-call.sh prepends "REVIEW_CONTEXT: ci" as a single line to the user message payload for all CI-dispatched reviews, and the marker does not alter the message structure or interfere with other CI augmentation
  ← Satisfies: "llm-api-call.sh prepends REVIEW_CONTEXT: ci to the user message payload for all CI-dispatched reviews"
- When this story is complete, reviewer-base.md contains a diff-boundary discipline section stating: when REVIEW_CONTEXT: ci is present, findings must not assert bugs about code not visible in the provided diff; when REVIEW_CONTEXT: ci is absent, full-codebase reasoning is permitted
  ← Satisfies: "reviewer-base.md includes a diff-boundary discipline section: when REVIEW_CONTEXT: ci is present, findings must not assert bugs about code not visible in the provided diff"
- When this story is complete, all 10 generated reviewer agent files are rebuilt via build-review-agents.sh and each file contains the diff-boundary discipline text
  ← Satisfies: "All 10 generated agent files inherit it via build-review-agents.sh"
- When this story is complete, unit tests include: a test verifying REVIEW_CONTEXT: ci IS present in payload when llm-api-call.sh is invoked from CI context (GITHUB_ACTIONS or equivalent env var set); a test verifying REVIEW_CONTEXT: ci is ABSENT from payload when invoked outside CI (no GITHUB_ACTIONS or equivalent)
  ← Satisfies: diff-boundary discipline gated correctly on CI context (RT-5)
- When this story is complete, unit tests are written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] diff-boundary section must use structural pattern (markdown heading + bullet list) compatible with a8e8-0b23 agent-authoring sub-agents
- [Reliability] REVIEW_CONTEXT: ci must be a single prepended line — verify it does not change the number of user message fields or break CI dispatch JSON parsing in 2fa0-a2d9 or 88d2-6756

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
